classification.difficultyReason: Same task as the cosine reading in p48-q1, on a tangent graph, with a 1 d.p. estimate.

content.prompt: This graph shows $\tan\theta$. Use it to estimate the following to 1 d.p.

answer.worked:
Read the height of the tangent curve at $\theta=25^{\circ}$.
$$\tan25^{\circ}\approx0.5$$

Read the height of the tangent curve at $\theta=55^{\circ}$.
$$\tan55^{\circ}\approx1.4$$

At $\theta=140^{\circ}$, the curve lies below the horizontal axis. Read its height.
$$\tan140^{\circ}\approx-0.8$$

At $\theta=310^{\circ}$, the curve lies below the horizontal axis. Read its height.
$$\tan310^{\circ}\approx-1.2$$
